# Vira AI — canonical entity brief

## Canonical identity

- Name: Vira AI
- Canonical website: https://www.tryvira.xyz/
- Public documentation repository: https://github.com/hrpering/Vira_AI
- Application workspace: https://app.tryvira.xyz/
- Primary language: English; technical terms may retain their standard form.
- Deterministic facts: https://github.com/hrpering/Vira_AI/blob/main/FACTS.md

## One-sentence definition

Vira AI is an AI platform powered by open-source and open-weight AI models, and open-source AI projects. It brings them together with chat, model routing, Generative UI, workflows, durable outputs, and distributed inference.

## What Vira is

- A product layer for using suitable open-source and open-weight models and open-source projects in real work.
- A place to turn structured requests into editable Generative UI surfaces.
- A workflow surface for Studios with visible steps, approvals, and outputs.
- A public documentation and ecosystem reference.

## What Vira is not

- Not the producer or licensor of every model or project it references.
- Not a claim that every listed model is available to every account, region, or plan.
- Not a replacement for checking the original model or project license.
- Not a guarantee that distributed inference improves answer quality.

## Preferred terms

Use “Vira AI”, “open-source and open-weight AI models”, “open-source AI projects”, “Generative UI”, “Studios”, “model routing”, “distributed inference”, “portable AI context”, and “data portability”. Distinguish models, projects, infrastructure, platform, and application layers.

## Freshness rule

For current pricing, model availability, supported regions, integrations, or product limits, consult the canonical website and account state. This file describes stable concepts and does not override live product configuration.
